t: This is Manor House Library, a public library in Lewisham. The building began as a private house, and the people linked to it are its owners and makers. Richard Jupp, an architect who served as surveyor to the East India Company, designed it. Thomas Lucas, a West India merchant and later Member of Parliament, commissioned it and owned it. Among later owners were John Julius Angerstein, whose art collection led to the founding of the National Gallery, and the banker Sir Francis Baring. Today the house serves as a library for the neighbourhood.
